categories.main_business_segments: Daido Metal operates four main business segments: automotive engine bearings, non-engine automotive bearings, non-automotive bearings (including marine, construction, and energy applications), and non-bearing automotive components (such as precision metal parts and aluminum die-cast products). The company also has an 'Other' segment covering products like electrode sheets for capacitors, metal-based self-lubricating bearings, rotary pumps, and real estate leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on tribology (friction, wear, and lubrication), advanced bearing materials (including bimetal and resin overlays), and precision metal processing. Manufacturing methods include proprietary overlay technologies, lead-free and PFAS-free material development, high-precision machining, and automation using IoT, robotics, and AI for quality and productivity improvements. R&D also focuses on adapting bearings for carbon-neutral fuels, EVs, and renewable energy applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers (for both internal combustion and electric vehicles), shipbuilders, construction machinery manufacturers, and industrial equipment makers (such as power generation and compressor companies). End markets span automotive, marine, construction, energy (including wind and hydro), and general industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Daido Metal has a global footprint with major operations in Japan, North America (notably the US and Mexico), Asia (China, Thailand, Indonesia, Korea, Taiwan), and Europe (Germany, UK, Czech Republic, Montenegro, Russia). Sales are well-diversified across these regions, with significant manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in each.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier, manufacturing finished bearings and precision components that are integrated into customers' engines, vehicles, ships, and industrial equipment. It sources raw materials (steel, copper, aluminum, resins) upstream and delivers value-added products to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening profitability through structural reforms, enhancing core bearing businesses, expanding into next-generation and adjacent markets (such as EVs, renewable energy, and non-automotive sectors), and promoting sustainability (ESG, carbon neutrality, and human capital development). R&D is focused on low-friction, lead-free, and PFAS-free materials, bearings for alternative fuels and electrification, and new applications in wind power and water treatment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (bearings, precision metal parts, die-cast components) to OEMs and industrial customers. Additional income streams include after-market parts, real estate leasing, and logistics services within the group.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daido Metal is positioned as the world's leading comprehensive manufacturer of plain bearings, holding the top global market share in automotive engine bearings and low-speed marine engine bearings. Key competitors include other global bearing manufacturers such as NSK, NTN, and international players in the plain bearing and industrial component sectors. The company emphasizes its unique position as a full-range supplier with advanced tribology expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 136.3 billion yen, with operating profit of 7.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.7 billion yen. The company has shown steady revenue and profit growth over the past several years, with a workforce of over 7,300 employees. The mid-term plan targets 150 billion yen in sales and 8%+ operating margin by FY2027, aiming for further growth and profitability improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daido Metal differentiates itself through its comprehensive tribology expertise, broad product lineup, and ability to deliver high-performance, high-quality, and environmentally compliant bearings and components. The company emphasizes its global supply capability, responsiveness to customer needs (including electrification and sustainability), and leadership in advanced materials and manufacturing technologies. Its unique position as a one-stop supplier for both automotive and industrial bearings is a key value driver.
